issue_context.summary: A long mixed-character Run query visibly overlaps the autocomplete text; after repeated editing, the reporter observed severe memory growth on a version predating later query-worker lifetime work.
known_information: The report targets PowerToys 0.97.2 on Windows 11 build 26200.
The mixed-character query produces the visual overlap after one more character.
The issue includes a screenshot showing substantial memory attributed to PowerToys Run.
The diagnostic archive includes no heap or runtime trace establishing memory retention.
PR 48394 is merged and included in the latest stable 0.101.2362.0.
A maintainer advised updating to the latest version because the reported memory issue was fixed several months ago.
Live upstream issue activity was reviewed through 2026-09-04T22:53:56Z.
inferences: The visual symptom is another instance of Issue 13554.
The separate stationary autocomplete surface likely contributes to the visual overlap.
The memory symptom is likely covered by PR 48394, but no evidence ties this occurrence to its stale-query worker mechanism.
The visual defect and memory growth are not established as one root cause.
issue_context.analysis: This report combines two separate symptoms. The exact long query is useful evidence for the canonical visual tracker, while the memory screenshot comes from a build predating the merged worker-lifetime fix. Because a collaborator has already requested the decisive update/retest and the reporter has not replied, the dashboard should show waiting-on-author rather than draft the same request again.
